Gold Farms

US PvP Alliance · prices at Thu 26 Nov 19:26 · cheapest auction

Where a level 60 can make gold solo in the open world. Drop chances are vanilla figures (Wowhead Classic where we have the page, VMaNGOS otherwise); WoW Forever may have changed some, and Forever-only items are listed from guide sites. Mob and item names open Wowhead; the BB tag beside an item opens its BootyBayBroker price history. Wowhead pages fetched so far: 143.

Mobs to farmRare spawnsMass-pull packs

Best mobs to farm

Open-world mobs level 40+ with at least 8 spawn points, ranked by value per kill: expected drops at today's cheapest auction plus the coin they drop. Coin + junk is that coin, every grey and green weapon or armor piece (random or not) at vendor price, and random blues and epics at their tiny drop chance, priced at the low end of the auction house (the lower of the cheapest auction and the market value, less the 5% cut). Drops that sell fewer than {STEADY_SOLD} a day (rare recipes, patterns and the like) are left out: one 100 pattern that sells twice a day is not gold you can farm. Tick "Show slow-selling drops" to count them at full price. Per 100 kills makes it easy to compare with how fast you kill. A mob matches the level filter if any of its levels is in range.

Mass-pull packs (level 30–63)

Open-world groups of 10+ hostile mobs whose spawn points sit within 30 yards of each other, for a build that can pull and kill a whole pack. Kills an hour assume 300 normal mobs (10 every 2 minutes), 360 elites up to level 50 and 90 above, less when the pack cannot respawn that fast (spawns × 60 ÷ respawn minutes). Event spawns (AQ war, invasions) and one-time spawns are left out. Gold an hour counts coin, greys and green weapons and armor at vendor price, random blues and epics at their tiny chance and the low end of the auction house (the lower of the cheapest auction and the market value, less the 5% cut), and each drop at today's cheapest auction less the 5% cut, but only as many as the market takes (a 3rd of a day's sales per hour; the rest at vendor price). Drops selling under 5 a day count at vendor price unless you tick "Show slow-selling drops". Drop chances, coin and respawns are VMaNGOS (vanilla) figures; "near" is the closest named place in the database, so check the map. Elite filter: packs that are mostly elites.
